name: UC4 - TFS Real-Time Screening & Freeze Orchestration (Fixed)

parameters.query: SELECT customer_id, full_name, cnic, country FROM customers WHERE customer_id = {{ $json.customer_id }};

SELECT watchlist_id, entity_name, id_number, list_type, country, GREATEST( similarity(lower(entity_name), lower('{{ $node["Fetch Customer Details"].json.full_name }}')), CASE WHEN id_number = '{{ $node["Fetch Customer Details"].json.cnic }}' AND id_number IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END ) AS match_score FROM watchlists ORDER BY match_score DESC LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Screen Against Watchlist
nodes.notes: Deterministic SQL match using Postgres pg_trgm trigram similarity + exact CNIC match. Reg 4 §8 requires SBP-REs to 'properly analyze any similarity' - this replaces the external ML microservice with a reproducible, inspectable SQL calculation. Requires: CREATE EXTENSION pg_trgm;

nodes.name: IF High Confidence Match
nodes.notes: Reg 4 §7(a): match >= 0.90 is treated as confirmed and freezes without delay or prior notice.

nodes.name: IF Grey Zone Match
nodes.notes: 0.60-0.89 requires human review before any freeze action (Reg 4 §8).

nodes.name: Manual Analyst Approval
nodes.notes: Pauses execution and exposes a resume webhook URL. Send that URL to the AML analyst (Slack/email) with approve/reject options. Analyst POSTs {"approved": true/false} to resume. Reg 4 §8 - human judgement call on the similarity.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO alerts (related_table, related_id, alert_type, severity, status) VALUES ('customers', {{ $node["Fetch Customer Details"].json.customer_id }}, 'TFS_MATCH', 'high', 'open') RETURNING alert_id;
UPDATE accounts SET status = 'frozen', frozen_reason = 'TFS MATCH - Reg 4' WHERE customer_id = {{ $node["Fetch Customer Details"].json.customer_id }} RETURNING account_id;

nodes.name: Freeze Account
nodes.notes: Reg 4 §7(a): freeze immediately, without delay, without prior notice.

nodes.name: File FMU Report
nodes.notes: Reg 4 §7(b): report frozen assets/attempted transactions to the FMU.

nodes.name: Set SBP SLA Deadline
nodes.notes: Reg 4 §7(c): freeze must be reported to SBP within 48 hours. This is recorded for the SBP filing payload/reporting - it does not pause the workflow.

string.name: notice_text
string.value:
=Dear {{ $node["Fetch Customer Details"].json.full_name }},

You are hereby notified that account ID {{ $node["Freeze Account"].json.account_id }} has been frozen without prior notice, pursuant to the United Nations Security Council Act, 1948 and the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997, in accordance with Regulation 4, Section 7(d) of the SBP AML/CFT/CPF Regulations and Form-B of the UNSC (Freezing and Seizure) Order, 2019.

This action follows a screening match against the sanctions watchlist (Watchlist Reference: {{ $node["Screen Against Watchlist"].json.watchlist_id }}).

Deposits (credits) may continue to be made to this account. No debits or withdrawals will be permitted unless a specific exemption is granted under the applicable order.

If you believe this action was taken in error, you may request a review under Regulation 4, Sections 9-10 of the SBP AML/CFT/CPF Regulations.

Compliance Department

nodes.name: Build Form-B Notice
nodes.notes: Static, deterministic template citing the exact clause. No LLM/RAG needed for a fixed-wording statutory notice - this is simpler and removes hallucination risk entirely.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO documents (related_table, related_id, document_type, retention_years, litigation_hold, file_reference) VALUES ('accounts', {{ $node["Freeze Account"].json.account_id }}, 'FORM_B_NOTICE', 10, FALSE, 'REF-FORM-B-' || {{ $node["Fetch Customer Details"].json.customer_id }}) RETURNING document_id;

nodes.name: Store Form-B Document
nodes.notes: Reg 8 §2: 10-year retention on CDD/account-related records, hard-coded not inferred.
